title: Answer an evaluation resend that owes nothing without waiting for the MCP service's shared store connection
outcome: Answer an evaluation resend that owes nothing without waiting for the MCP service's shared store connection
acceptance: An exact evaluate resend that owes no session registration and no focus move is answered from a read even while another call on the same MCP service holds the shared writable store connection
A behaviour test drives that resend through the evaluate word while a concurrent word on the same service holds the connection
